topology: 4 nodes x1 H100, NVSHMEM star over the NIC: ranks 1-3 push a full slot to rank 0, rank 0 answers each with slot/8
workload_note: `asym_patterns hub 4096 3` with ONE GPU PER NODE and -p ib. Every edge crosses the NIC, so the whole star is visible in rank space rather than only the parts that happened to cross a node boundary. Volume is asymmetric by 8x in the two directions, which is what a symmetrising aggregate would hide. Deliberately does NOT load p2p: it has an open illegal-memory-access bug (PLAN-20260810-0854) that poisons the CUDA context and costs the capture.
